metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Inner Leg Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix inner thigh pain for good!

A common cause of groin and inner leg pain is due to tightness and weakness in the muscles that support this area, especially the adductor muscles. 

So we're going to focus on fixing this with exercises that will help lengthen and strengthen the muscles at the same time. That way we can get quick and long lasting pain relief. 

As a bonus, these can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give quick groin and inner thigh pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and get rid of inner leg pain for good!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:00 Inner Leg Arc
3:10 Side Lunge Glides
5:51 Adductor Rocker
7:54 Adductor Wall Slide
